title: Accessibility | ContextMint
description: ContextMint marketing site accessibility statement — WCAG 2.2 Level AA design target, scope, and contact.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.p1Before: ContextMint Ltd aims for the public marketing website at
commitment.p2: This statement covers the marketing site only. It does not cover the ContextMint VS Code extension, desktop Engine, or customer-hosted API deployments.

measures.title: Measures we take
items: Semantic HTML landmarks, labelled navigation, and skip-to-main-content
Keyboard support for menus, dialogs, carousels, and forms
Visible focus indicators and minimum target sizes for primary controls
Colour contrast targets for body text and primary calls to action
Optional select-to-speak for reading highlighted page text
Automated axe checks on key pages in continuous integration after site build

conformance.title: Conformance status
conformance.textStrong: designed to conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA
conformance.textAfter: . This is not a claim of third-party certification. Known limitations and remediation history are tracked in the site repository accessibility audit notes.

limitations.title: Known limitations
items: Screenshot carousels rely on keyboard focus within the carousel region; autoplay pauses when the region is focused or when reduced-motion preferences are set.
Select-to-speak uses the browser Web Speech API; voice quality and language coverage depend on the visitor’s operating system and browser.
Some dense documentation pages may still contain long tables or code samples that benefit from further readability review.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.text: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this website, contact us. Please include the page URL and a short description of the issue.
